title: iHRIS 4.3.3 code list: csd_provider_gender
description: The `csd_provider_gender` code list as iHRIS 4.3.3 ships it by default: 2 codes from ihris-common/module/csd-data-gender. Each term's notation is the iHRIS record id and its label the record's `name`. The source gives no definitions, so every term is a candidate.
